adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` now removes membership via `group.users.delete(user_id)` (has_many :through delete) and then calls `group.save`. Previously, membership removals went through `group.remove(user)` (see removed `update_patch` logic), so this change bypasses any custom logic/callbacks that `Group#remove` (or the join model) may perform. From the diff alone we can verify the bypass and that `group.save` can’t undo an already-executed association delete, but we cannot verify the specific claim about cached `groups.user_count` or particular destroy callbacks because the `Group`/`GroupUser` association definitions and callbacks are not shown here.
